units: <cite ref="Ketubot 111a:16">Keth. 111ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="R00033"><he>צבי</he></cite>, <cite ref="Ezekiel 26:20">Ez. XXVI, 20</cite>) <he>ארץ שצִבְיוֹנִי בה מתיה חיים וכ׳</he> the dead of the land in which I have my desire, shall be revived &c. (v. <cite ref="R00035"><he>צְבִי</he></cite> 1).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:5">Gen. R. s. 10</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="R00292"><he>צבא</he></cite> <cite ref="Job 7:1">Job VII, 1</cite>) <he>וכל צִבְיוֹנוֹ של וכ׳</he> and all the desire of man refers to what is earthly.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:17">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> (play on <he>הצבבה</he>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 4:8">I Chr. IV, 8</cite>) <he>שעשה צביונו וכ׳</he> he did the will of the Lord; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Chullin 60a:1-9">Ḥull. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>כל … בקומתם … ברעתם … בצִבְיוֹנָם נבראו</he> all the works (animals) of creation were created in their full-grown stature, with their consent, with their pleasure (in their mission, with ref. to <he>צבאם</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 2:1">Gen. II, 1</cite>); [Rashi: according to the shape of their own choice]; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 11a">R. Hash. 11ᵃ</cite> (v. Ms. M., Rabb. D. S. a. l.).
